_comment: The block cache's hash-keyed table: the chain walk, the unlink on remove, and the replace-in-place, each broken in turn. tests/test_cache.cpp drives the cache through its public interface, and its last test brings a pair of sixteen-byte keys with the same 64-bit hash -- found by cycle-finding over hash64, pinned because the filters on disk fix the hash -- so a chain of two exists and comparing only its head is caught.
